subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – pricing plans and thank-you redirect
body_text:
Hi Priya,

Thank you for your time on our call. You wanted to offer monthly and yearly plans on one checkout page and send customers to your own thank-you page after purchase. Here is a quick summary.

What we resolved:
- You added a yearly price, and you confirmed that both the monthly and yearly options now show at checkout.
- You set the after-purchase redirect to your own thank-you page, and your test purchase took you straight to it.

What we covered:
- We discussed how to add GST to your prices and mentioned that there is a tax setting for it.

Your next steps:
1. Add your privacy policy link to the checkout footer (you mentioned you would do this this week).

What we'll do next:
- We will send you our guide on the tax settings so you can follow the steps.

Our call continued across two recordings, so here are both parts in order:
Part 1: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-06-PART-1
Part 2: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-P2-06-PART-2

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Riya
FlexiFunnels Support
